title: Reproducibility materials for ‘Co-occurrence Patterns and Shared Genetically Associated Traits of Ischaemic Heart Disease and Depressive Disorders’
description: This release contains analysis scripts, derived outputs, figure-source material, software records, checksums, and step-by-step access instructions supporting a global ecological analysis of ischaemic heart disease and depressive disorders. It preserves the 15,703-record IEU OpenGWAS catalogue snapshot and aggregate discovery reconstruction, and adds the completed targeted instrument-level sensitivity follow-up for the final 29 reported traits against IHD and DD (58 exposure-outcome pairs). The follow-up includes 232 estimator results (IVW, MR-Egger, weighted median, and weighted mode), heterogeneity, Egger-intercept, instrument-strength, single-SNP, leave-one-out, and 58 MR-PRESSO analyses, with code, cached analytical inputs, validation records, and readable supplementary outputs. Version 1.1.0 also adds the parameterised GBD Incidence/Rate preprocessing chain for 204 locations and 1992-2021, verified against retained downstream matrices. The MR work is exploratory and does not establish causal effects. Source GWAS and GBD data remain subject to provider terms; credentials, signed URLs, and complete third-party source files are not redistributed.
